casual.custom: Own scene design: an empty open-air hillside amphitheatre in clear afternoon daylight. She sits sideways on a broad stone step after a long walk, enjoying one orange. A waist-up frontal three-quarter composition at eye level, face clearly visible; her own left elbow stays beside her torso and the left hand cups the orange at waist height, while her own right forearm bends naturally in front of her and her right hand pulls one strip of peel free. Her outfit is an original fitted cobalt-blue halter waistcoat with a deep diamond-shaped neckline, narrow ivory piping and pointed petal-cut hems above the bare midriff, paired with saffron fitted tulip shorts joined to a slim belt by two side tabs. Fully opaque and secure, bare shoulders and arms, no outer layer. She wears one small wheel-shaped bracelet; a round stone lies on the adjacent step as the sole source-inspired object. The scene feels restful and playful, with the warm stone terraces receding behind her; no other people, creatures or armor.
